name: Vehicle Rental Service 4
definition: Vehicle rental service provides detailed vehicle rental information.

CompanyName.name: Company Name
CompanyName.definition: Name of the vehicle rental company.

CompanyIdentification.name: Company Identification
CompanyIdentification.definition: Identification of the vehicle rental company.

CompanyBusinessName.name: Company Business Name
CompanyBusinessName.definition: Business name of the vehicle rental company.

CompanyLegalCorporateName.name: Company Legal Corporate Name
CompanyLegalCorporateName.definition: Legal Corporate Name of the vehicle rental company.

CompanyAddress.name: Company Address
CompanyAddress.definition: Address of the vehicle rental company.

CompanyLocalData.name: Company Local Data
CompanyLocalData.definition: Contains local language equivalent(s) of the vehicle rental company data.

CompanyContact.name: Company Contact
CompanyContact.definition: Contact details at vehicle rental company location.

RenterName.name: Renter Name
RenterName.definition: Name of the vehicle rental customer.

RenterCorporateName.name: Renter Corporate Name
RenterCorporateName.definition: Corporate name of the vehicle rental customer.

RenterCorporateIdentifier.name: Renter Corporate Identifier
RenterCorporateIdentifier.definition: Corporate identifier of the vehicle rental customer.

RenterCorporateIdentifierAssigner.name: Renter Corporate Identifier Assigner
RenterCorporateIdentifierAssigner.definition: Party assigning an identification to a vehicle rental customer.

AdditionalDriver.name: Additional Driver
AdditionalDriver.definition: Type of identification of the additional vehicle rental customer.

LoyaltyProgramme.name: Loyalty Programme
LoyaltyProgramme.definition: Loyalty programme of car rental applied.

SummaryCommodityIdentification.name: Summary Commodity Identification
SummaryCommodityIdentification.definition: Provides the identifier assigned by the card acceptor that best categorizes the items being purchased in a standardized commodity group.

NoShow.name: No Show
NoShow.definition: Indicates that the cardholder failed to pick up the vehicle and was therefore charged a no-show fee; vehicle was not actually rented.

RentalAgreementNumber.name: Rental Agreement Number
RentalAgreementNumber.definition: Contains the original vehicle rental agreement, invoice or contract number.

Adjusted.name: Adjusted
Adjusted.definition: Indicates that an adjustment was made to a vehicle rental charge (for example, additional charges added).

PickupLocation.name: Pickup Location
PickupLocation.definition: Used when different than rental location

CheckOutDate.name: Check Out Date
CheckOutDate.definition: Date the vehicle was picked-up by the customer.  In the case of a no-show transaction or a prepaid transaction, this contains the scheduled pickup date.

CheckOutTime.name: Check Out Time
CheckOutTime.definition: Time the vehicle was picked-up by the customer.  In the case of a no-show transaction or a prepaid transaction, this contains the scheduled pickup time.

ReturnLocation.name: Return Location
ReturnLocation.definition: Location to which vehicle was returned.

CheckInDate.name: Check In Date
CheckInDate.definition: Date when the vehicle was returned to the rental agency.

CheckInTime.name: Check In Time
CheckInTime.definition: Time when the vehicle was returned to the rental agency.

ClassInvoiced.name: Class Invoiced
ClassInvoiced.definition: Contains the classification of the vehicle (for example, economy, intermediate, luxury, etc.) on invoice

MakeInvoiced.name: Make Invoiced
MakeInvoiced.definition: Brand or manufacturer of the vehicle on invoice.

ModelInvoiced.name: Model Invoiced
ModelInvoiced.definition: Product line of vehicle within the make on invoice.

RegistrationNumberInvoiced.name: Registration Number Invoiced
RegistrationNumberInvoiced.definition: Registration number of vehicle on invoice.

ClassProvided.name: Class Provided
ClassProvided.definition: Contains the classification of the provide vehicle (for example, economy, intermediate, luxury, etc.)

MakeProvided.name: Make Provided
MakeProvided.definition: Brand or manufacturer of the provided vehicle.

ModelProvided.name: Model Provided
ModelProvided.definition: Product line of provided vehicle within the make.

RegistrationNumberProvided.name: Registration Number Provided
RegistrationNumberProvided.definition: Registration number of the provided vehicle.

DistanceUnit.name: Distance Unit
DistanceUnit.definition: Unit of measure used to compute the distance.

OdometerStart.name: Odometer Start
OdometerStart.definition: Odometer reading at start of rental (at the time of vehicle check-out).

OdometerReturn.name: Odometer Return
OdometerReturn.definition: Odometer reading at return of rental (at the time of vehicle check-in).

TotalDistance.name: Total Distance
TotalDistance.definition: Total distance expressed in unit of measure.

FreeDistance.name: Free Distance
FreeDistance.definition: Maximum free miles or kilometres for the car rental period.

DistanceRate.name: Distance Rate
DistanceRate.definition: Defines the rate in relation to a specific distance.

Insurance.name: Insurance
Insurance.definition: Indicates whether or not insurance was purchased.

AdditionalAmount.name: Additional Amount
AdditionalAmount.definition: Contains the details of additional amount for a specific vehicle rental service type.

Tax.name: Tax
Tax.definition: Taxes related to the products or services.

PrivateData.name: Private Data
PrivateData.definition: Reserved for private data. The use of this data element is determined by bilateral agreement.

NationalData.name: National Data
NationalData.definition: Reserved to define data unique to the country applications.
